meta.name: atlas-recon
meta.description: Documentation reconnaissance for takeover — find all docs, assess accuracy, freshness, coverage, and discoverability, and identify critical knowledge gaps. Use when asked "what docs exist", "documentation assessment", or "knowledge gaps".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估文档质量与覆盖度，发现知识缺口
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对现有文档做全面体检并找出缺失内容。
copy.tagline_en: Assess documentation quality, coverage, and identify gaps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a comprehensive review of your docs and spot missing information.

howto.what: 安装后，当用户询问文档情况时，Claude 会扫描项目中的所有文档，评估每份文档的准确性、新鲜度、完整性和可发现性，并识别关键知识缺口，最后生成一份覆盖率地图。
howto.when: 当用户询问“有哪些文档”、“文档评估”或“知识缺口”等问题时触发。

say.text: 检查这个项目里有哪些文档？
say.note: Claude 会扫描并列出所有文档

say.text: 评估一下这些文档的准确性和新鲜度。
say.note: Claude 会逐份评估并标记过时或不准确的内容

say.text: 找出文档中缺失的关键知识。
say.note: Claude 会识别未记录的关键领域

howto.what_en: When asked about documentation, Claude scans the project for all docs, assesses accuracy, freshness, completeness, and discoverability, and identifies critical knowledge gaps, then produces a coverage map.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks 'what docs exist', 'documentation assessment', or 'knowledge gaps'.

say_en.text: Check what docs exist in this project.
say_en.note: Claude will scan and list all documentation.

say_en.text: Assess the accuracy and freshness of these docs.
say_en.note: Claude will evaluate each doc and flag stale or wrong ones.

say_en.text: Find missing key knowledge in the docs.
say_en.note: Claude will identify undocumented critical areas.
